audit.why: Even-to-Swain lane (53.33% WR, 450 games): Talon owns 1 and 3-5, you flip at 6 when Demonic Ascension survives his combo, he reclaims tempo at first lethality item, you outscale. Content layer says this; full chart lagged.
Spikes correct and complete (4 entries): level 3 all-in, your 6, his lethality item, your late scale.

audit.whatIsWrong: cooldowns field had no digits; two copy-paste-bleed bullets; full chart rows 2, 3, 5, 6 said 'Skill' against content/packet Talon/Talon/Talon/Swain; packet flags zero sequencing cues; missing-interaction: Assassin's Path cuts your retreat and Swain has no dash.
audit.why: Rake is 9s rank 1 / 7s max, Noxian Diplomacy 8s with kill refund, Shadow Assault 100/80/60s. suspectNames entry ('Demonic Ascension's') is a false positive — correct name with a possessive.

edits.before: W completes the setup: vision + slow from across the map. Root-into-W never misses, and the passive soul fragments heal you.
edits.after: Level 3 completes his Q-W-auto all-in — your slow root rarely peels it. Hug tower and give up CS rather than eat the combo.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-spam stops costing the lane. Poke the wave contact and pull every rooted target with the passive.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay his — the burst chunks you to kill range before Nevermove lands. Ward both sides and spend nothing greedy.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: the drain outpaces their damage in any extended fight. Force rivers, root the entry, ascend, profit.
edits.after: His lethality spike and 100/80/60s Shadow Assault roams reclaim tempo — track the R, match his roams, and hold the wave.

edits.before: Late Swain is the anti-team: flank-root their engage, ascend in their backline, and demonflare the clump that forms around you.
edits.after: Two items in you outscale — his burst falls off into your HP while R uptime and AoE E-Q anchor every grouped fight you force.

edits.before: - Talon Rake: matchup-defining — The boomerang return is most of his lane damage — stand off the return line. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Nevermove has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Rake (W): 9s rank 1, 7s max — the boomerang return is most of his lane damage; stand off the return line. - Noxian Diplomacy (Q): 8s, refunded on kills. - Shadow Assault runs 100/80/60s: his roam timer. Your Nevermove is 12s — hold it for his Q leap.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Vision of the Empire reaches 5500+ units — cover raptors and the side-lane paths when he shoves and vanishes; the reveal beats his stealth roam.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: Noxian Diplomacy refunds health and cooldown on kills — chasing through a low wave feeds resets and Assassin's Path escapes.

edits.before: Talon wins by landing Rake, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Talon wins by vaulting walls you cannot follow, stacking Wounds fast, and cashing the all-in before 6.
